Name: EPIC outputs

GeneratedBy.Description: Partially using the EPIC pipeline B0 fieldmaps used as inputs to this pipeline in order to correct for magnetic field inhomogeneities within MRI volumes. Once B0 corrections are made using the EPIC method, FreeSurfer's mri_average is called to average the echos of a single variable flip angle to create a single volume

Description: This is a dataset from a Variable Flip Angle (VFA) scan which has been processed partially through the EPIC pipeline and computed synthesized volumes that are corrected for B0 magnetic field inhomogeneity and the echos of a single flip angle were averaged together to create a single volume.
